entry_points.text: Time services include preempt-guarded local reader, running-clock alias, and idle sleep/wakeup hooks inert when stable, not running or suspended.
Cgroup migration clears stored source every call but notifies only with source, bound scheduler under cgroup mutex and operation bit set, treating missing or cgroup-less groups as root.

exports.text: Autogroup fork inherits current grouping, detach returns to default, create attaches immediately, exit releases reference; nice permission allows reduction or requires privilege.

hazards.text: Torn narrow-counter reads, lost polling-aware wakeups, stale throttled time, misordered leaf traversal, premature empty observation and wrong shared/private lock word risk fairness, accounting, liveness and lock-balance faults.

Waking current task while delayed/blocked, reweight against wrong queue, blocked/offline CPU assignment, migration-disabled violation and post-boot unstable marking warn; unprivileged autogroup nice changes are throttled heavyweight ops.
No eligible CPU is fatal; pressure counter underflow and inconsistent flag transitions raise one-time errors with sticky defect marker; delayed handling without migration marking warns.

invariants.text: Estimate uses sticky marker cleared on movement and re-armed after adoption/smoothing/retention; refresh reports decay change; delayed contributes nothing, others use queued presence or weight; throttled time subtracts throttled duration; attachment ages load with direct or validated reads; entity keeps delay, membership, weight, linkage, averages, estimate, timestamps; clock prefers stable offset, raw before running, else per-CPU.

Full builds walk ancestor chains with leaf bookkeeping and refresh, minimal builds handle one entity with no-op leaf/propagation; descendants precede ancestors via flag and branch anchor with tail append, beside-parent insert, orphan extension and connection assertion; idle test, load scaling, group refresh, autogroup membership, share setting and task-to-queue linkage collapse to trivial forms when disabled.

Migration serializes against runqueue locking, resolves cgroup then autogroup identity; autogroup applies only to root members with non-exiting threads preferring signal autogroup when enabled; relocation holds signal lock across swap, drops old reference after release, and skips identical targets.

Reschedule funnels through eager wrapper into locked core with lazy promotion for idle, duplicate suppression, local flag set or polling-aware remote delivery via compare-exchange merge; preemption dispatches on class match else forces reschedule when newcomer outranks next, requesting clock-update skip when donor stays queued.

Idle/root groups reject weight changes with clamping and no-op on unchanged; reweight detaches/reattaches averages updating totals only when queued; completion saturates and wakes under lock, simple-wait wakes oldest when non-empty; autogroup nice validated against min/max with forty-entry table, throttled unprivileged changes, identity/path shown only for genuine groups; boot disables autogroup; header guarded.

Current-task wakeup is lock-free fast path, others check state/queue/residency/placement via waking state with migration and I/O accounting; eligibility needs affinity plus active/online/dying rules with ordered runqueue-then-CPU publication; proxy return clears blocked links; core scheduling tracks participation by linkage/cookie, advances sequence, stamps first-queued time and reschedules when forced idle ends.

locks.text: Runqueue acquisition disables interrupts then takes shared core word or private queue word per core-scheduling state with nesting; nested path validates selector stability and drops preemption guard without rescheduling.

Pin records lock state, restricts clock flags to skip requests, clears per-acquire state and asserts empty callbacks except tolerated push entry; release is unpin then interrupt-enabled unlock with clock-cache invalidation; repin restores state and merges stashed flags.
Per-CPU share propagation takes each runqueue with interrupts saved and refreshes clocks; placement and forced affinity replacement run under priority-inheritance and runqueue protection.

state_machines.text: Deferred callbacks splice as linked list under lock, drain by unlinking before invocation, preserving distinguished push entry to avoid observable empty list across sections.

Clock stability moves unstable/stable via boot/runtime events; stable marking computes continuity offset and clears tick dependency, instability schedules async replication to all processors disabling irqtime accounting.

Pressure accounting separates restore, delayed, runnable-migration and fresh wakeup; group mutation adjusts per-condition counters with underflow detection, derives some/full masks, accumulates durations and schedules averaging/polling work under write guards.

structs.text: Autogroup holds reference count, scheduling-group link, admin semaphore, identity and nice. Per-CPU clock keeps raw, wall and scheduler timestamps plus global offsets, running/stable indicators and early-boot assumption.

Utilization control keeps per-task requested/effective values with bucket identity and activity, per-runqueue aggregates with bucket totals/maxima and idle retention, respecting system defaults and group restrictions with inert forms when disabled.
Wakeup statistics counted only when enabled, separating local/remote, attributing remote to domain hierarchy, counting migration, total and synchronous events with inert disabled forms.
